en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a hilly town with dense trees and numerous houses and multi‑storey buildings on the ridge. A tall church with a pointed spire dominates the skyline to the right, with other historic-looking structures nearby. In the lower area are smaller houses and industrial buildings with smokestacks. The word "Leisnig." is printed in red at the top left, a handwritten number appears near the top center, and on the right edge in red is the publisher information and a number.
